case_scope: Observed requested events, retaining occurrence multiplicity and partial traces within the natural-language scope.
notes: 원천·사건 인스턴스·활동·인코딩 고정. Case ET와 trace 분포 변화는 잔여 교란; JOIN 수와 논리 깊이 분리. Case 집계 효과가 함께 변하므로 순수 JOIN 인과효과로 해석하지 않음. 인접 수준이 데이터상 1:1일 수 있음. Aggregated case log does not identify each individual passenger/bag; do not infer individual duration or comparison. Preserve occurrence multiplicity (UNION ALL); no deduplication or tie-breaking. MAX TOTAL JOIN DEPTH describes authored reference SQL, not a proven minimum.
case_key_policy: Canonical flight_id; structured (flight_no, operating_date=date(scheduled_offblock)) accepted after full-scope bijection; no inferred composite strings.
alternative_case_policy: Strict canonical Entity; only approved same-entity key representations normalized.
